newsitem.title: USA: US late spot propane stable, activity almost nil.
newsitem.headline: US late spot propane stable, activity almost nil.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices were little changed late Friday from late Thursday, players said, but activity was skimpy as traders flocked to an industry outing in Texas sponsored by Mobil Corp.
Mont Belvieu propane was sold for 35.75 cents and 36.0 cents, while Conway material changed hands at 36.25 cents a gallon, players said.

"There were just a few bargain-hunters picking up barrels after mid-morning; everyone else seems to be out playing golf," one Houston player said, adding the propane market had been bolstered late Thurday by end-user buying.
